transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

My regular doctor sent me. Um... everyone is just making a big fuss because they say my weight has dropped too low. I don't really see the problem, honestly. Being this light... it just helps me keep up with the shop. Keeps me from getting slowed down. That's all.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I wouldn't say afraid, exactly. It's just... well, if I eat anything heavy, or let myself have the kinds of foods we used to make for holidays... I do start worrying right away. 

I just worry that I'll gain weight and... lose the grip I've worked so hard to keep. So I prefer to just keep things how they are.
Do you think your weight is currently at a healthy level?
I... yes, I think it's fine. My husband and the apprentices at the shop keep saying I look too thin, but... I tell them I'm fine. I think people just confuse discipline with sickness. That's all.
Are you worried that if you gain weight, it will get out of control?
I don't... I wouldn't really use those words. I just... I don't really think about it like that. I just know what works for me right now, and I'd rather keep it that way.
Do you think you look too thin?

No, I... I just said, I think I'm fine. I know my husband and the apprentices keep telling me I look too thin, but... I don't see it that way. I just think they don't understand the difference between being disciplined and being sick.
Do you think your weight or shape has anything to do with your self-worth?
I don't really... I don't know what you mean by that. I just do my work. I don't sit around thinking about things like self-worth. It's just my body. It's just how I am.
Are you ever afraid of eating because you think you might gain weight?

I don't know about afraid. But... if I eat anything heavy, or... those foods we used to make for the holidays... I do start worrying right away. I just don't want to gain weight and lose the grip I've worked so hard to keep.
Do you feel like you have control over what you eat?

I suppose. I mean... yes. Like, on workshop days, I usually just have tea. Maybe a few careful bites of something. Stopping for a real meal just... it feels unnecessary. It throws off the control I've got over the day. So I just keep it simple.
Do you think your eating habits help you feel more in control of your life?

I don't really know. I don't sit and analyze my whole life like that. It's just... a routine. I just do what I need to do to get through the day, get my work done. I'm not sure if it means anything else.
Have you had your period in the last few months?
No. I mean... I'm 59. So... no, not for a long time.
Do you want to be thinner than you are now?
I don't really know. I mean... I'm not aiming for anything specific. I just... I don't want to gain. I prefer to just stay how I am. It's just easier that way.
Are you ever anxious about gaining weight?

I suppose so. I mean... if I eat anything heavy, or... you know, those holiday foods we used to make... I start worrying right away. I just think I'll gain weight and... lose the grip I've worked so hard to keep. So, yes, I get anxious about it.
Do you think gaining a small amount of weight, like a few pounds, would be acceptable to you?
No. I... I don't think so. Like I just said a moment ago, even a little bit makes me worry I'm losing that grip I have. So... no. I wouldn't be okay with that.
Do you feel like you're eating less because you're afraid of what might happen if you gain weight, or because it helps you feel more in control of things?

I suppose... it's more about the control. When I'm working, anyway. Like, on workshop days, I usually just have tea... maybe a few careful bites of something. 

Stopping for a real meal just feels unnecessary to me. It... it throws off the control I’ve got over the day. So I just keep it to that.
Do you think your weight is the same as what you see in the mirror?

I don't know. I just see what's there. My husband and... the apprentices at the shop, they keep saying I look too thin. But I just tell them I'm fine. I think people are just confusing discipline with sickness, that's all.
Do you think your weight or shape is different from how others see it?
I don't really know. Like I said, they have their opinions. I just... I see myself how I am. I don't really think about how they see it.
When you look in the mirror, do you see yourself as being underweight?
No. I just see... me. I don't see what the fuss is about.
When you look in the mirror, do you think you look normal?

Yes. I look fine. Like I said earlier... it's my husband and the apprentices who keep going on about me being too thin. I just tell them I'm fine. People just... they confuse discipline with being sick. I just look normal to me.
Do you believe that gaining weight would directly affect your ability to maintain control over your daily life and work?

I suppose. If I... if I eat anything heavy, or even just the foods we used to make for the holidays... I start worrying right away. I just worry that I’ll gain weight and... lose the grip I’ve worked so hard to keep. So, yes. I just prefer to stick to my routine.
Do you think your fear of gaining weight is because of how you think you would look?
I don't know. I don't really think about it like that. It's not about... vanity, or anything. I just don't want to.
